name: Sliding Text Reveal
description: A text reveal template where words slide in from behind a mask. Great for title sequences and section headers where you want the text to feel deliberate.

name: Sliding Title Reveal [Apple Event]
description: A title reveal template inspired by Apple keynote presentation design. Good for premium product announcements and polished presentation openers.

name: Snappy Text Stretch
description: A snappy text template inspired by film festival announcements. Great for animated event promos and any brand making a bold opening statement.

name: Squeeze
description: An animation template from Antinomy where elements compress and snap back with an elastic physical quality. Works for expressive UI transitions and motion design that wants to feel less digital.

name: Stretch
description: An animation template from Antinomy where elements stretch and snap back with an elastic quality. Works for expressive UI transitions and motion design that wants to feel a bit more physical.

name: Stretched Type Repeater
description: A stretched type animation combined with a repeater for bold, rhythmic typographic motion. Ideal for titles, social content, and brand animations.

name: Text Extrusion
description: A text extrusion effect that adds depth and dimension to animated typography. Perfect for titles, logos, and 3D-style motion graphics.

name: Text Mirror Effect
description: A template where text is mirrored into a symmetrical composition. Work great for artistic title sequences and editorial motion design.

name: Text Scramble
description: An animated text template inspired by streaming platform teasers. Great for entertainment drops and any brand building anticipation for a release.

name: The Crust: Animated Menu
description: An animated menu template inspired by bakery and café signage. Great for daily specials, new menu launches, and any restaurant highlighting menu items.

name: The Crust: Lunch Time
description: A bold, oversized typography template inspired by bakery signage and packaging design. Great for product launches and any restaurant or food brand that wants a punchy title moment.

name: The Crust: Slideshow
description: An animated close-up slideshow template inspired by pastry photography. Great for product showcases, seasonal menu drops, and any food brand highlighting their ingredients.

name: The Crust: Tagline
description: A tagline template inspired by bakery photography. Great for brand statements, "freshly baked" promos, and any food brand pairing a strong message with product imagery.

name: The Crust: Tagline and Menu
description: A animated menu template inspired by bakery and sandwich shop boards. Great for menu rollouts, seasonal lineups, and any food brand or restaurant showcasing multiple items at once.

name: The Edit: Instagram Story
description: A story edit template with smooth cuts and a layout built for the Instagram format. Drop in your own content and it's ready to go.

name: The Edit: Product Launch
description: A product launch template with bold cuts and a pace that builds toward the reveal. Perfect for new product announcements and e-commerce campaigns where the buildup matters.
